title.en: Isotopic abundances of silicon from two measured isotope amount ratios (IUPAC 2024, Example 4B)
title.tr: Ölçülen iki izotop miktar oranından silisyumun izotop bollukları (IUPAC 2024, Örnek 4B)

description.en: x₂₈ = 1/(1 + R₂₉/₂₈ + R₃₀/₂₈), x₂₉ = R₂₉/₂₈·x₂₈, x₃₀ = R₃₀/₂₈·x₂₈: three outputs from two inputs, with the covariance matrix Σ_y = JΣ_xJᵀ (Formula 3).
description.tr: x₂₈ = 1/(1 + R₂₉/₂₈ + R₃₀/₂₈), x₂₉ = R₂₉/₂₈·x₂₈, x₃₀ = R₃₀/₂₈·x₂₈: iki girdiden üç çıktı; kovaryans matrisi Σ_y = JΣ_xJᵀ (Formül 3).

explanation.en: Valkiers et al., Mixture III: R₂₉/₂₈ = 0.050 0657(25), R₃₀/₂₈ = 0.032 9035(34) mol/mol, taken as uncorrelated. The Jacobian is x₂₈²·[[−1, −1], [1 + R₃₀/₂₈, −R₂₉/₂₈], [−R₃₀/₂₈, 1 + R₂₉/₂₈]].
explanation.tr: Valkiers vd., Karışım III: R₂₉/₂₈ = 0,050 0657(25), R₃₀/₂₈ = 0,032 9035(34) mol/mol, ilişkisiz alınmıştır. Jakobiyen x₂₈²·[[−1, −1], [1 + R₃₀/₂₈, −R₂₉/₂₈], [−R₃₀/₂₈, 1 + R₂₉/₂₈]]'dir.

explanation.en: x₂₈ = 0.9233873(36), x₂₉ = 0.0462300(22), x₃₀ = 0.0303827(30) mol/mol. The abundances sum to 1, so their covariance matrix is singular; r(x₂₈, x₂₉) = -0.54, r(x₂₈, x₃₀) = -0.79.
explanation.tr: x₂₈ = 0,9233873(36), x₂₉ = 0,0462300(22), x₃₀ = 0,0303827(30) mol/mol. Bolluklar toplamı 1 olduğundan kovaryans matrisi tekildir; r(x₂₈, x₂₉) = -0,54, r(x₂₈, x₃₀) = -0,79.

sources.document: Possolo et al., A brief guide to measurement uncertainty (IUPAC Technical Report), Pure Appl. Chem. 96 (2024) 113–134
